description: Activate when: user says 'how do I level up my thinking', 'why do I keep copying others', 'I don't know what I don't know', 'how do I develop independent judgment', or their reasoning shows systematic deference to authority, inability to form original views, or frustration at being stuck at the same thinking level for years. Do NOT activate when: the person needs domain knowledge rather than thinking structure (content gap, not cognition gap), or when motivation and engagement are the real issue rather than cognitive development. More: deciqai.com/c/nine-level-cognitive-tower
